mapper.sql: DR.NO , DR.REG_DATE , DR.UPDATE_DATE , DR.ENABLED , DR.UID , DR.PUBLIC_ACCESSIBLE , DR.PARENT_NO , DR.OWNER_NO , DR.CREATION , DR.LAST_MODIFIED , DR.NAME , DR.ABSOLUTE_PATH , FALSE AS IS_FILE
FL.NO , FL.REG_DATE , FL.UPDATE_DATE , FL.ENABLED , FL.UID , FL.PARENT_NO , FL.OWNER_NO , FL.FILE_LENGTH , FL.FILE_TYPE , FL.CREATION , FL.LAST_MODIFIED , FL.EXTENSION , FL.NAME , TRUE AS IS_FILE
mapper.select:
SELECT
, P.UID AS PARENT_UID FROM BN_DIRECTORY DR INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY P ON DR.PARENT_NO = P.NO WHERE DR.NO = #{dirNo}

SELECT
,DR.UID AS PARENT_UID ,DR.ABSOLUTE_PATH AS DIRECTORY_PATH ,FL.NAME || '.' || FL.EXTENSION AS FULL_NAME FROM BN_FILE FL INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY DR ON FL.PARENT_NO = DR.NO WHERE FL.UID = #{uid}
SELECT CASE COUNT(1) WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RES FROM ${tableName} WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}

SELECT FILE_NO , UPDATE_DATE , TITLE , SUBJECT , CREATOR , LAST_MODIFIED_BY , CREATE_DATE , MODIFY_DATE , KEYWORDS , DESCRIPTION , HEADING_PAIRS , COMPANY FROM BN_FILE_DOCUMENT WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo};
mapper.update: UPDATE BN_FILE_DOCUMENT SET UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , TITLE = #{title} NULL , SUBJECT = #{subject} NULL , CREATOR = #{creator} NULL , LAST_MODIFIED_BY = #{lastModifiedBy} NULL , CREATE_DATE = #{createDate} NULL , MODIFY_DATE = #{modifyDate} NULL , KEYWORDS = #{keywords} NULL , DESCRIPTION = #{description} NULL , HEADING_PAIRS = #{headingPairs} NULL , COMPANY = #{company} NULL WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_NO , UPDATE_DATE , MAKE , CAMERA_MODEL_NAME , ORIENTATION , F_NUMBER , EXPOSURE_TIME , SENSING_METHOD , FLASH , LIGHT_SOURCE , WHITE_BALANCE , SHUTTER_SPEED , ISO , IMAGE_WIDTH , IMAGE_HEIGHT , CREATE_DATE , MODIFY_DATE , GPS_LATITUDE , GPS_LONGITUDE FROM BN_FILE_IMAGE WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}

SELECT FILE_NO , UPDATE_DATE , MIME_TYPE , AUTHOR , DURATION , PREFERRED_RATE , PREFERRED_VOLUME , AUDIO_FORMAT , AUDIO_BITS_PER_SAMPLE , AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE , LAYOUT_FLAGS , AUDIO_CHANNELS , COMPRESSOR_VERSION , CAMERA_MODEL_NAME , FIRMWARE_VERSION , AVG_BITRATE , ROTATION , IMAGE_WIDTH , IMAGE_HEIGHT , CREATE_DATE , MODIFY_DATE , GPS_LATITUDE , GPS_LONGITUDE FROM BN_FILE_VIDEO WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}

SELECT FILE_NO , UPDATE_DATE , MIME_TYPE , SAMPLE_RATE , CHANNELS , BITS_PER_SAMPLE , TOTAL_SAMPLES , TITLE , ARTIST , ALBUM , GENRE , ALBUM_ARTIST , DISCNUMBER , ALBUM_DATE , ORGANIZATION , TRACK_NUMBER , DURATION FROM BN_FILE_AUDIO WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}
SELECT FILE_NO , UPDATE_DATE , ARCHIVE_FORMAT , TOTAL_ENTRIES , UNCOMPRESSED_SIZE , COMPRESSION_RATIO , ENCRYPTED , PASSWORD_PROTECTED , COMMENT FROM BN_FILE_ARCHIVE WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}
SELECT THUMBNAIL AS BIN_DATA FROM BN_FILE_THUMBNAIL THM INNER JOIN BN_FILE F ON THM.FILE_NO = F.NO WHERE F.UID = #{fid}

SELECT d.NO , d.PARENT_NO , CAST(d.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , d.NAME , d.ABSOLUTE_PATH , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = d.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY d WHERE 1=1 AND d.PARENT_NO = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY_ACCESS da WHERE da.DIR_NO = d.NO AND da.GROUP_NO = #{groupNo} ) ORDER BY d.NAME

SELECT d.NO , d.PARENT_NO , CAST(d.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , d.NAME , d.ABSOLUTE_PATH , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = d.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY d INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY p ON d.PARENT_NO = p.NO WHERE 1=1 AND p.UID = #{parentUid} ORDER BY d.NAME

SELECT
, DR.ABSOLUTE_PATH AS DIRECTORY_PATH , FL.NAME || CASE WHEN FL.EXTENSION IS NOT NULL THEN '.' || FL.EXTENSION ELSE '' END AS FULL_NAME , CASE WHEN THM.FILE_NO IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS HAS_THUMBNAIL FROM BN_FILE FL INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY DR ON FL.PARENT_NO = DR.NO LEFT OUTER JOIN BN_FILE_THUMBNAIL THM ON FL.NO = THM.FILE_NO WHERE 1=1 AND DR.UID = #{dirUid} AND FL.ENABLED = TRUE ORDER BY FL.NAME

SELECT
FROM BN_DIRECTORY DR INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY PR ON DR.PARENT_NO = PR.NO WHERE 1=1 AND PR.UID = #{uid} AND DR.ENABLED = TRUE ORDER BY DR.NAME

WITH RECURSIVE DIR_PATH ( NO, PARENT_NO, UID, NAME, LVL ) AS (
SELECT d.NO, d.PARENT_NO, d.UID, d.NAME, 1 AS LVL FROM BN_DIRECTORY d WHERE d.UID = #{uid}
UNION ALL
SELECT p.NO, p.PARENT_NO, p.UID, p.NAME, dp.LVL + 1 AS LVL FROM BN_DIRECTORY p JOIN DIR_PATH dp ON dp.PARENT_NO = p.NO WHERE p.NO != dp.NO ) SELECT * FROM DIR_PATH ORDER BY LVL DESC
